parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

parameters.name: AuthEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable forced Simple Authentication and Security Layer (SASL) authentication. After this feature is enabled, clients that do not perform SASL authentication cannot access the cluster

parameters.name: AutopurgePurgeInterval
parameters.description: The reserved field.

parameters.name: AutopurgeSnapRetainCount
parameters.description: The reserved field.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The cluster ID.

parameters.name: ConfigAuthEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable RAM authentication for the configuration center in Nacos:

- `true`: enabled

- `false`: disabled

> Before you set this parameter, call the QueryConfig operation to obtain the ConfigAuthSupported parameter to check whether the current cluster supports this feature.

parameters.name: ConfigSecretEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the configuration encryption feature for the configuration center in Nacos. Valid values:

- `true`: The request was successful.

- `false`: The request failed.

> Before you set this parameter, call the QueryConfig operation to obtain the ConfigSecretSupported parameter to check whether the current cluster supports this feature.

parameters.name: ConfigType
parameters.description: The format of the configurations. Supported formats include TEXT, JSON, XML, and HTML.

parameters.name: ConsoleUIEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the Nacos open-source console

parameters.name: Enable4lw
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the four-character command access feature

parameters.name: EurekaSupported
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable Eureka protocol support in Nacos

parameters.name: ExtendedTypesEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable TTL configuration in ZooKeeper parameters.

parameters.name: InitLimit
parameters.description: The maximum connection duration of the instance. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID.

parameters.name: JuteMaxbuffer
parameters.description: The maximum amount of data on each node. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Unit: bytes.

parameters.name: MCPEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether MCP is enabled in Nacos configuration. Valid values:

- `true`: enabled

- `false`: disabled

> Before you set this parameter, call the QueryConfig operation to obtain the MCPSupported parameter to check whether the current cluster supports this feature.

parameters.name: MaxClientCnxns
parameters.description:
The number of connections between a single client and a single server in ZooKeeper configuration.
If this parameter is set to 0, no limits are imposed on the number of connections.

parameters.name: MaxSessionTimeout
parameters.description: The maximum timeout period in ZooKeeper configuration. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: MinSessionTimeout
parameters.description: The minimum timeout period in ZooKeeper configuration. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: NamingAuthEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable RAM authentication for the Accreditation Centre in Nacos:

- `true`: enabled

- `false`: disabled

> Before you set this parameter, call the QueryConfig operation to obtain the NamingAuthSupporte parameter to check whether the current cluster supports this feature.

parameters.name: OpenSuperAcl
parameters.description:
Specifies whether super permissions are enabled. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Valid values:

- `true`: enabled

- `false`: disabled

parameters.name: PassWord
parameters.description:
The password of the account.

> This parameter is required when OpenSuperAcl is set to true.

parameters.name: RequestPars
parameters.description: The extended request parameter in the JSON format.

parameters.name: SnapshotCount
parameters.description: The frequency at which snapshots are generated in ZooKeeper configuration

parameters.name: SyncLimit
parameters.description: The connection timeout period of the instance. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: TLSEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable TLS transmission link encryption in Nacos

parameters.name: TickTime
parameters.description: The time unit. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Default value: 2000. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description:
The username of the account.

> This parameter is required when OpenSuperAcl is set to true.
